What is BAI?
BAI (Bundle APKs Installer) is an app that lets you install multiple APKs as if it was a single package. This is useful for installing apps that are distributed as App Bundles since Android provides no built-in way to install them from sources other than Google Play.

How to use BAI?
Click "Install APKs" button and select base APK and additional configuration-specific APKs or a ZIP archive that contains all required APKs, then click "Select" button to start installation process.

.apks
You can rename a .zip archive that contains .apk files to .apks (e.g.: somesplitapp.zip -> somesplitapp.apks), so it can be opened with BAI from other apps.

Installing apps from external storage
You can long click install button to select files via system file picker that supports external storage.

Seriously, read this one-time warning!

Sorry for taking your time, but I'm really tired of people with MIUI who have been skipping the previous version of this warning.

Looks like your device is running MIUI. MIUI is known for breaking standard Android API features and a lot of BAI users have reported installations failing on MIUI for no reason with "Installation failed". Usually it can be fixed by disabling MIUI optimizations in developer settings, which I suggest you should do.

Of course you can try using BAI without disabling MIUI optimization, but if it doesn't work, try disabling it before complaining to me about failed installations. If your MIUI version doesn't have that toggle or it doesn't help, there's nothing I can do.

This issue is supposed to be fixed on MIUI 20.2.20 and up (xiaomi.eu and eu-based ROMs).

Managed backups are currently in beta, please report issues in BAI's GitHub repo (you can find the link on about screen)

Backup files format
BAI backups apps as .apks files (which are just ZIP archives with .apk files) with some meta information added to the archive (such as app name and icon). Backed up .apks files can still be installed as normal .apks files (because they are normal .apks files, except for some additional files in the archive which are ignored by installer)

What is backed up
Currently BAI backups only apps APK files (no data/obb/etc)

External changes to backup directory
BAI doesn't automatically keep track of external changes done to files in the backup directory. So, if you've changed them outside of BAI, use reindex option in 3-dots menu at the top right of backup screen to rescan backups directory.

You can always open this help from the 3-dots menu at the top right of backup screen
